explanation: The crusaders had taken Antioch the year before, after a long siege. Saladin recaptured Jerusalem in 1187, and later crusaders held it again only briefly.

claims.text: The First Crusade captured Jerusalem in July 1099.
The First Crusade took Antioch in 1098, passed through Byzantine Constantinople as allies, and did not take Damascus.
The crusaders captured Antioch in June 1098 after a siege of about eight months.
Crusaders regained Jerusalem by treaty from 1229 to 1244.
